name: Date Picker
description: A single-date field with a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.

anatomy.description: The button-like input showing the formatted date.
The month grid with full keyboard navigation.
Previous and next buttons around an announced month label.
Grid buttons bounded by the min and max dates.

dos: Set minDate and maxDate when only a planning window is valid.
Explain what the date drives, like a milestone, in the description.
Keep the caller-owned value as a Date, not a string.
donts: Don't use it for ranges; use DateRangePicker.
Don't expect free-typed input; the calendar is the parser.
Don't disable dates silently; state the valid window in the description.

examples.title: Calendar selection
examples.description: Arrows move between days, Enter selects, min and max bound the range.

examples.title: Bounded planning window
examples.description: minDate and maxDate limit picking to the current sprint window.

guidance.useWhen: Users pick a single calendar date.
guidance.avoidWhen: The value is free-form or a range; use Input or a dedicated range flow.
guidance.behavior: The calendar supports full keyboard navigation and min/max bounds.
guidance.responsive: The popover collision-handles; the field keeps its layout width.

keyboard.action: Opens the calendar from the field.
Moves the focused day by one day.
Moves the focused day by one week.
Selects the focused day and closes the calendar.

notes: Day buttons use a roving tab index, so the calendar grid is a single Tab stop.
The month label is announced with aria-live as the view changes.
Dates outside minDate and maxDate are disabled and cannot be selected.
